item.title: Copilot edit responses have a length limit
item.body:
Type: Bug Asking Copilot to make edits and formatting on a 7000-line file and it fails with the error "Sorry, the response hit the length limit. Please rephrase your prompt." Of course it is impossible to give any steps to "reliably reproduce" this problem since we can't see any part of the generated response, its length or the allowed length. Needless to say, this error is profoundly useless as it is not possible to know the length of the generated result of any prompt, and any limit to response length (especially the completely unknown "too long" here) is something that the backend needs to handle. It is not a user issue that either a question or a reply can be too long. It is the responsibility of the backend to divide, handle and reassemble any data that might be too long for the system or model.
